title: Circular Queue of Primes
src: Walmart OA (college not given; 2 coding questions + 35 MCQs). Coding question 1.
body:
You are given two positive integers N and P.

Write all primes less than or equal to N in increasing order. They form a circular queue: after the last prime comes the first one again, and so on forever.

Walk along this queue from the front, keeping a running sum of the primes you pass. Return the 0-based position in the queue (the index of that prime within the list of primes up to N) of the first prime that makes the running sum strictly greater than P.

Function to complete

Complete firstCrossIndex(N, P). It returns the 0-based index in the queue of the prime that makes the sum exceed P.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
out: One integer: the 0-based position in the queue.

samples.ex: The queue is 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19. Running sums: 2, 5, 10, 17, 28. The sum first exceeds 25 at 11, which is at index 4.
The queue is 2, 3. Sums: 2, 5, then (wrapping round) 7 at index 0. 7 > 5, so the answer is 0.

spec.returns: the 0-based index in the queue of the prime that makes the sum exceed P

wrong.why: does not wrap around the queue
uses >= instead of strictly greater, and loops one prime at a time
